collector.sql: SELECT pg_catalog.current_database() as datname, relpages as lo_pages FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON (n.oid = c.relnamespace) WHERE n.nspname = 'pg_catalog' AND c.relname = 'pg_largeobject';

descriptions.lo_pages: Estimated number of pages in the pg_largeobject table

collector_pg_stat_wal.sql: SELECT wal_records, wal_fpi, wal_bytes, wal_buffers_full, CASE WHEN stats_reset IS NULL THEN '-infinity' ELSE pg_catalog.rtrim(pg_catalog.rtrim(pg_catalog.to_char(stats_reset AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US'), '0'), '.') || 'Z' END AS stats_reset FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_wal

descriptions.wal_buffers_full: Number of times WAL data was written to disk because WAL buffers became full. Only available on PG 14+
descriptions.wal_bytes: Total amount of WAL generated in bytes. Only available on PG 14+
descriptions.wal_fpi: Total number of WAL full page images generated. Only available on PG 14+
descriptions.wal_records: Total number of WAL records generated. Only available on PG 14+

collector_pg_stat_wal_17.sql: SELECT wal_write, wal_sync, wal_write_time, wal_sync_time, CASE WHEN stats_reset IS NULL THEN '-infinity' ELSE pg_catalog.rtrim(pg_catalog.rtrim(pg_catalog.to_char(stats_reset AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US'), '0'), '.') || 'Z' END AS stats_reset FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_wal

descriptions.wal_sync: Number of times WAL files were synced to disk via issue_xlog_fsync request (if fsync is on and wal_sync_method is either fdatasync, fsync or fsync_writethrough, otherwise zero). Only available on PG 14 to 17.
descriptions.wal_sync_time: Total amount of time spent syncing WAL files to disk via issue_xlog_fsync request, in milliseconds (if track_wal_io_timing is enabled, fsync is on, and wal_sync_method is either fdatasync, fsync or fsync_writethrough, otherwise zero). Only available on PG 14 to 17.
descriptions.wal_write: Number of times WAL buffers were written out to disk via XLogWrite request. Only available on PG 14 to 17.
descriptions.wal_write_time: Total amount of time spent writing WAL buffers to disk via XLogWrite request, in milliseconds (if track_wal_io_timing is enabled, otherwise zero). This includes the sync time when wal_sync_method is either open_datasync or open_sync. Only available on PG 14 to 17.

collector_pg_wal.sql:
WITH s AS (SELECT max(setting::float8) FILTER (WHERE name = 'wal_segment_size') AS seg,
  max(setting::float8) FILTER (WHERE name = 'min_wal_size') AS min_mb, max(setting::float8) FILTER (WHERE name = 'max_wal_size') AS max_mb,
  max(setting::float8) FILTER (WHERE name = 'wal_keep_size') AS keep_mb, max(setting::float8) FILTER (WHERE name = 'max_slot_wal_keep_size') AS slots_mb
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_settings WHERE name IN ('wal_segment_size','min_wal_size','max_wal_size','wal_keep_size','max_slot_wal_keep_size')),
w AS (SELECT count(*)::float8 AS n FROM pg_catalog.pg_ls_waldir() WHERE name ~ '^[0-9A-F]{24}$')
SELECT v.value, v.pg_wal FROM s, w, LATERAL (VALUES ('count', w.n), ('size', w.n * s.seg),
  ('min', s.min_mb * 1048576 / s.seg), ('max', s.max_mb * 1048576 / s.seg), ('keep', s.keep_mb * 1048576 / s.seg),
  ('slots_max', CASE WHEN s.slots_mb = -1 THEN 'NaN'::float8 ELSE s.slots_mb * 1048576 / s.seg END)) AS v(value, pg_wal)

descriptions.pg_wal: Total size in bytes of WAL segments in the '/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata/pg_wal' directory  computed as (wal_segment_size * count)

collector_pg_wal_archive_status.sql:
SELECT v.value, v.pg_wal_archive_status FROM (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE name LIKE '%.ready')::float8 AS ready,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE name LIKE '%.done')::float8 AS done FROM pg_catalog.pg_ls_archive_statusdir()) c,
  LATERAL (VALUES ('ready', c.ready), ('done', c.done)) AS v(value, pg_wal_archive_status)

descriptions.pg_wal_archive_status: Number of WAL segments in the '/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata/pg_wal/archive_status' directory (ready, done)

collector_sync_replicas.sql: SELECT 'observed' AS value, CASE WHEN s = '' THEN 0 WHEN s ~ '(?:ANY|FIRST) ([0-9]+) \([^\n]*\)' THEN pg_catalog.substring(s, '(?:ANY|FIRST) ([0-9]+) \([^\n]*\)')::float8 ELSE -1 END AS sync_replicas FROM pg_catalog.current_setting('synchronous_standby_names') AS s
